name: Roger Mitsumori
source:
Hobby: Nothing
Special Skill: Perfectly repeating the same skill over and over like a machine

The chief patissier of the 'Salon do te Nui'.
He's bad at dealing with people, but only with the protagonist he feels some closeness.
